name: Hadapsar
civicNote: Within PMC; its remaining Sade Satra Nali part was merged in 2017.
summary: A large suburb in east Pune on the Pune-Solapur highway, combining an industrial estate, IT parks and large townships.
knownFor: Magarpatta City, Amanora Park Town and SP Infocity
Site of the 1802 Battle of Poona
connectivity: Hadapsar railway station serves local trains
Kharadi bypass links Hadapsar to the Pune-Ahmednagar highway
suits: Professionals working in Magarpatta, SP Infocity or the industrial estate, and families wanting large townships.
